title: On the sharp constants in curl-Sobolev inequalities on $\mathbb{S}^n$
summary: Let $n\equiv 3\ (\mathrm{mod}\ 4)$ and set $p=\frac{n-1}{2}$. On an oriented Riemannian $n$-manifold we consider the (middle-degree) curl operator, $\mathrm{curl}:*\mathrm{d}:Ω^{p}\rightarrowΩ^{p}$, and the associated conformally invariant Sobolev quotients on $(\mathbb{S}^n,g_{\mathrm{st}})$, \[ J_1(α)=\frac{\big(\int|\mathrm{curl}α|^{\frac{2n}{n+1}}\,\mathrm{dV}\big)^{\frac{n+1}{n}}}{\int\langle\mathrm{curl}α,α\rangle\,\mathrm{dV}}, \qquad…
